registry_name: Project Compass AI Tool Domain Registry

source.name: Microsoft Purview supported AI sites
source.note: Domains are seeded from the Microsoft Purview supported AI sites list. Risk levels are sample Project Compass classifications, not Microsoft official ratings.

risk_level_meaning.low: Known enterprise or mainstream AI service. Allow with standard monitoring and approved data use.
risk_level_meaning.medium: Known AI service with user input, file upload, or unclear enterprise controls. Allow with restrictions or review.
risk_level_meaning.high: Consumer generative AI, media generation, code execution, deepfake, face swap, unknown data retention, or impersonation risk. Review or block until approved.
